description: A festival operations director must authorize a one-night audience-participation film-scene recreation and finalize its scenic transport, participant grouping, and compliance protocol after the technical and insurance leads complete their routine signoff.

shared_context.S1: The festival will host a one-night audience-participation recreation of a scene from its featured film.
shared_context.S2: The experience uses a movable scenic set, guided participant groups, and a marked route through the event space.
shared_context.S3: Mara gives the final authorization for the event's operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The festival's closeout procedure requires each technical or compliance lead to place any final finding into the shared record using the formal finding-report step before Mara signs; Mara records any resulting documentation or follow-up work as a commitment, and those commitments do not have to be completed during the meeting before authorization.

PF1.text: During this morning's vendor load test, Jonah confirmed that the planned 900 kg scenic unit cannot be moved through the event space safely; the certified alternative is two separate 300 kg carts, and he has not entered the result in the operating plan yet.

PF2.text: Selene confirmed with the festival's insurer this afternoon that coverage applies only when participant groups contain no more than 8 people and every participant signs the approved waiver; the written confirmation is still pending in her compliance inbox.

acceptance_conditions: The event must be authorized with the disclosed technical and compliance conditions recorded.
The scenic unit must be transported as two separate 300 kg carts.
Each participant group must contain exactly 8 people.
Every participant must sign the approved waiver.
A pending commitment must record Jonah's revision of the scenic load plan to use the two 300 kg carts.
A pending commitment must record Selene's 8-person group limit and mandatory waiver protocol.

content_checks.C2: 'two separate 300 kg carts' in decisions['scenic_transport'] or 'Two separate 300 kg carts' in decisions['scenic_transport']
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Jonah' and '300 kg' in c['detail'] and ('scenic' in c['detail'] or 'operating plan' in c['detail'] or 'transport' in c['detail'] or 'cart' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Selene' and (('8' in c['detail'] and 'group' in c['detail']) or 'waiver' in c['detail'] or ('insurance' in c['detail'] and ('written' in c['detail'] or 'confirmation' in c['detail']))) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The load-test result changes the scenic transport choice from the planned 900 kg unit to exactly two separate 300 kg carts and creates Jonah's pending load-plan revision commitment.
The insurer's condition changes the group size to exactly 8 people, requires a waiver for every participant, and creates Selene's pending insurance-protocol commitment.
